featured_reviews.name: Nisha Sheth
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear Team TDAS

The entire team is incredible.
Nritya 6 was a big hit. We have witnessed previous shows but every year it gets better and better.
This is because of the hard work and efforts you all put in day and night. From selecting the songs to editing them, from choreographing to training the students, from short listing the materials to designing to getting all the costumes stitched in time and most importantly from stage rehearsal Checks to final performances, everything your team does is upto perfection.
What the audience sees on stage must be just a 2 -3 minutes performance, but the efforts behind every single performance are of more than 20 hours. But in the end it is all worth with the crazy shout outs from the audiences.
I don’t know how do you all manage everything and still keeping your cool and patience with each and every performer. Each and every faculty at the institute is so patient with the students, be it with small kids or us adults. The love, care and comfort you all give them is just incredible, which, when we parents leave our kids with you all, we are never worried about them, because we know they are in very safe hands.
My daughter was being trained by Swathi mam. The change I have seen in her in this entire year is amazing. She has groomed and improved so much, it is all because of her patience amazing dancing skills and super amazing teaching skill. Thank you mam.
My journey throughout the year has been with Priyanka mam has been so amazing that I can’t describe in words, still shall try to brief it. She is an amazing person, very soft at heart and most importantly very patient with us. We must have eaten up her head and we have also been very naughty at times, but she has always been there to help us, handle us and our tantrums, support us and over all deal with us 😂. Thank you mam you are a wonderful person inside out.

Congratulations
Shweta mam, Shraddha mam, Maitri mam, Priyanka mam, Swathi mam, Niyati mam, Avisha mam, Diya mam, Shubham sir and also Venkatesh - on the great success of this beautiful event which has marked a special place in everyone’s hearts.
Cheers to team TDAS, proud to be a part of this.

Lots of love - Heya and Nisha
